title: How to use AI minds as expert advisers
seoTitle: How to use AI minds as expert advisers
description: What an AI mind is, how to pick minds that disagree, and how to use them as reviewers, council seats and partners for your AI specialists, honestly.
lede: An AI mind lends you a famous thinker's way of working, built from their public work. This guide shows you how to pick minds that disagree, use them as reviewers and council seats, pair them with specialists, and stay honest about what they are.
